name: print-vending-kiosk
description: Production Ready Self-Service Printing Kiosk Software
author: InstaPrint Technologies

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix agent && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --names BACKEND,AGENT --prefix-colors cyan,yellow "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix agent"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
